content.user_title: Improve Pull Requests With Review-Ready Context
content.value_statement: Unclear pull requests slow reviews and hide risk. This skill structures PR context, checklists, testing notes, and reviewer guidance for faster decisions.
actual_capabilities: Generates structured pull request descriptions with summary, changes, rationale, testing, risks, and dependencies.
Builds context-aware review checklists based on changed file types and security considerations.
Suggests ways to split large pull requests into smaller reviewable units.
Creates risk summaries using size, complexity, test coverage, dependency, and security factors.
Drafts review response templates for clarification, follow-up changes, and technical explanations.
Provides examples for coverage reports, architecture diagrams, and PR templates.
limitations: It does not replace running project tests, linters, or security scanners.
It needs accurate diff, branch, and testing context to produce useful output.
It cannot guarantee reviewer approval or detect every project-specific risk.
Some examples require adaptation before use in a real repository workflow.

use_cases.title: Prepare Feature Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Create a complete feature PR description with acceptance criteria, implementation notes, tests, and reviewer focus areas.

use_cases.title: Review Large Changes
use_cases.description: Summarize large diffs, identify risk factors, and suggest logical split points before asking for review.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Review Workflows
use_cases.description: Generate reusable checklists and response patterns that make code reviews clearer and more consistent.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic PR Description
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a small change with known test results.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pull request description for this change. Include summary, what changed, why it changed, tests run, risks, and reviewer checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for polishing a PR description before review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this draft PR description for clarity and reviewability. Keep facts unchanged, add missing context, and highlight unclear areas that need my input.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Review Risk
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for larger changes with mixed file types.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this PR for review risk. Consider size, complexity, testing, dependencies, security impact, rollback difficulty, and suggested reviewer focus areas.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-PR Split
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for separating a broad branch into reviewable units.
prompt_templates.prompt: Propose a sequence of smaller pull requests for this branch. Group files by logical unit, define review order, and explain dependencies between PRs.

output_examples.input: A developer asks for a PR description after adding search filters and updating tests.
output_examples.output: A structured PR summary with changed behavior, implementation notes, test coverage details, risk notes, and a focused reviewer checklist.

output_examples.input: A lead asks whether a branch with many files should be split before review.
output_examples.output: A size and risk assessment with suggested split groups, review order, and reasons each group can be reviewed independently.

output_examples.input: A reviewer asks why one implementation approach was chosen over another.
output_examples.output: A concise response explaining the decision, alternatives considered, tradeoffs, and the planned follow-up if needed.

best_practices: Provide the base branch, diff summary, test results, and any deployment constraints before using the skill.
Review generated risk notes against project knowledge before publishing the pull request.
Keep final PR descriptions factual, concise, and aligned with your team template.
anti_patterns: Do not paste secrets, private customer data, or unreleased business information into prompts.
Do not use generated checklists as proof that tests or reviews were completed.
Do not ask the skill to hide risky changes or minimize important reviewer context.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps create clear pull request descriptions, review checklists, risk notes, testing summaries, and response drafts.

faq.question: Does it run Git commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides guidance and examples. Any repository commands should be run deliberately in your own environment.

faq.question: Can it replace code review?
faq.answer: No. It prepares review context, but human reviewers still need to inspect the code and validate behavior.

faq.question: What inputs make the output better?
faq.answer: Provide the diff summary, base branch, issue link, testing evidence, screenshots, deployment notes, and known risks.

faq.question: Can it help split a large pull request?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest logical PR groups, review order, and dependencies when you provide file and change context.

faq.question: Is it useful for non-code changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help document configuration, documentation, testing, and process changes when the PR context is clear.
